name: Taylor Devices Inc.
summary:
Taylor Devices (TAYD) reported earnings of $0.14 per share on revenue of $7.30 million for the fiscal first quarter ended August 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $0.86 per share on revenue of $13.20 million. The company missed consensus estimates by 83.72% while revenue fell 26.40% compared to the same quarter a year ago.

TAYLOR DEVICES INC. designs, develops, manufactures and markets tension control, energy storage and shock absorption devices for use in various types of machinery, equipment & structures.
